gloss: in the end; after all is said and done

definitions.gloss: in the end; after all; when all is said and done; ultimately
definitions.explanation: An expression used to sum up a situation or state a final conclusion after considering various factors. Slightly more emphatic or deliberate than plain {結局|けっきょく}, signaling that the speaker has weighed the matter carefully.

examples.japanese: {結局|けっきょく}のところ、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{来|こ}なかった→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{結局|けっきょく}のところ、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？
examples.english: What are you trying to say, when it comes down to it?

examples.japanese: ⟦{色々|いろいろ}→色々：02352_iroiro⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}した→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{結局|けっきょく}のところ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦よかった→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: After considering various options, the first proposal turned out to be the best after all.

notes:
An extended form of ⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧ (in the end). Adding ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧ gives a slightly more reflective, summing-up tone — the speaker is stepping back to give a final assessment.

FORMS:
⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧ + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧. Can also be written as ⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧ with kanji.

USAGE:
Typically placed at the beginning of a clause or sentence. Interchangeable with plain ⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧ in most contexts, but sounds slightly more measured or formal.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧: in the end (most common, neutral)
- {結局|けっきょく}のところ: when all is said and done (slightly more deliberate)
- ⟦つまり→つまり：03530_tsumari⟧: in short, that is to say
- ⟦{要|よう}する→要する：14342_yousuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in other words, to put it simply
